extension.description: Display header Doxygen documentation as compact, collapsible inline comments above C/C++ definitions.
command.goToDeclaration: C++ HeadDoc: Go to Header Declaration
configuration.title: C++ HeadDoc
configuration.enabled: Enable C++ HeadDoc in this workspace.
configuration.showCodeLens: Show header documentation summaries above function definitions.
configuration.showHover: Show full header documentation when hovering a function name.
configuration.showInlineComments: Show readonly header documentation as wrapped inline comment threads.
configuration.inlineCommentsExpanded: Expand inline documentation when it first appears. The default is collapsed for a compact initial view.
configuration.inlineCommentTextSize: Relative text size for inline documentation, rendered with native Markdown typography.
configuration.summaryStyle: Select which documentation fields appear in CodeLens summaries.
configuration.maxSummaryLength: Maximum CodeLens summary length in Unicode characters.
configuration.showParametersInCodeLens: Include parameter summaries in CodeLens when the selected style supports them.
configuration.showReturnValueInCodeLens: Include the return value in CodeLens when the selected style supports it.
configuration.headerExtensions: Extensions treated as C/C++ header files.
configuration.sourceExtensions: Extensions treated as C/C++ source files.
configuration.maxCommentSearchLines: Maximum number of lines searched above a header declaration.
configuration.debounceMs: Delay before refreshing CodeLens after editor or file changes.
configuration.maxCacheEntries: Maximum number of in-memory documentation cache entries.
configuration.logLevel: Verbosity of the C++ HeadDoc output channel.
